issues.question: Whether the evidence at trial permitted a rational jury to find knowing and willful falsity of the charged answer and its materiality under 18 U.S.C. § 1001(a)(2).
issues.standard_of_review: De novo review of preserved Rule 29 sufficiency; evidence and reasonable inferences in government favor; not a credibility retrial.
issues.preservation_status: Preserved at close of government evidence and all evidence, renewed within 14 days after verdict.
issues.appellant_theory: The answer referred to reconciliation of records, not a representation of personally seeing every item; the wording and contemporaneous records do not exclude a reasonable understanding of a truthful answer. Actual decision process and ability to affect it must be evaluated.
issues.appellee_theory: Interview context, prior discussion and certification support a rational inference the speaker knowingly represented physical verification; answer could influence monitoring even if follow-up continued.
issues.appellant_relief: Reverse conviction and direct judgment of acquittal for insufficient evidence.
issues.ruling_quote: The renewed motion for judgment of acquittal is denied.
issues.preservation_quote: Defense renews the Rule 29 motion on falsity, knowledge and materiality.
